name: Hydrogen direct reduction of iron
principle: Iron ore pellets are reduced to sponge iron by hydrogen instead of natural gas, then melted in an electric arc furnace. HYBRIT's Luleå pilot made more than 5,000 t of sponge iron with 98 to 99% metallisation between 2018 and 2024. IEA rates DRI based on 100% electrolytic hydrogen at TRL 6.

performance.metric: sponge iron produced in HYBRIT pilot
cost gap of H2 DRI versus blast furnace
performance.basis: IEA GHR 2025: 20 to 80% versus unabated natural-gas DRI; upfront cost 40 to 140% higher than gas DRI at commercial scale

source.note: IEA Global Hydrogen Review 2025 (collected in corpus/iea-reports): H2 DRI cost gap

reference_plants.name: HYBRIT pilot, Luleå
reference_plants.capacity: more than 5,000 t sponge iron in total

reference_plants.name: Stegra Boden hydrogen-DRI steel plant, Sweden
reference_plants.capacity: integrated green hydrogen, iron and steel plant; about USD 7 bn raised; on track for startup in 2026 with about 2.5 Mt/yr initial capacity scaling toward 5 Mt/yr by 2030; EUR 975 m completion round launched Oct 2025

source.note: gasworld, 13 Oct 2025 (EUR 975 m round); h2invest (about USD 7 bn raised, 2026 startup); steelradar Apr 2025 (5 Mt/yr by 2030); read 2026-10-28
IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, dataset of 24 July 2026, latest assessment (IEA 1-11 scale): 'DRI production based on 100% electrolytic hydrogen' 6 (2025)

advantages: Scope 1 and 2 emissions near zero in the pilot (under 0.05 t CO2e/t steel)
